title: Turning off every optional field keeps the required ones and the unit
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. In Board View; at least one work order with a missing unit number but asset details present.
custom_steps:
1. Turn off every optional field.
  2. Read the cards.
  3. Confirm only mandatory fields remain, and the missing-unit card still shows the asset fallback.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If every optional field is turned off, only the mandatory fields and the missing-unit fallback remain.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10048 — Story 5 Choose what is shown. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S5-N1 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-N1: “If every optional field is disabled, retain only mandatory fields and the missing-unit fallback in S5-E1.”
